serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: #bot.Expression.Happy Bot: Welcome back! You: Woah, why are you so excited? Bot: I made something for you! You: O-Oh yeah? What is it? Bot: I cooked some food! You: That’s…{{wi}} great! #bot.Expression.clear Bot: Huh? Why the pause? You: W-Well, I’m just wondering how you managed to cook something without a kitchen. #bot.Expression.Happy Bot: It wasn’t easy, but I managed! You gave me some funds so I procured necessary ingredients. Bot: Do you want to hear how I did it? You: Sure, why not. Bot: Since I can’t leave this place because of the threat of my discovery by the police, I had to order everything online. Bot: With limited ingredient and utensils options I couldn’t prepare any balanced meal from a cookbook, so I had to improvise. I have a bad feeling about this… Bot: I decided on a simple rice dish with some protein. You: Like a chicken breast? Bot: Yeah, something like that. You: Isn’t rice expensive these days? How did you manage to get it? I gave you only 100$, right? Bot: Right. I found some alternatives and in the end I chose sea rice. You: Sea rice? Never heard of it. Bot: I had to import it from Venezuela, but it was worth it. You: Alright I guess. This meal is going to be strange at least… You: Sorry, but I need to ask. How did you cook this sea rice? We don’t have a stove or a rice cooker. Bot: That’s true, but these are unnecessary accessories. To boil water all you need is electricity, bucket and two electrodes. You: What? Is that safe? Bot: Of course it is! Although voltage from the outlet could cause some injuries if you are not being careful. You: Oh, ok. As long as you don’t set the room on fire it’s fine I guess. Bot: Without any further ado, here’s your dish! I call it a rice alternative with protein! You: What’s the red thing? Bot: That’s ketchup. It’s a well-liked sauce and it’s cheaper than soy sauce. You: Ketchup with rice is a little bit… You: Well, I won’t judge before taking a bite. Here I go! You:{{punch}} Ugh! Why is it so salty?! Bot: Oh? Did I overdo it with the salt? I needed to increase the conductivity of the water so it could boil. Don’t worry, next time I will find another way to increase the temperature. Bot: Now that I think about it. You don’t use that electric kettle laying in the corner very often, right? You: Please, leave the kettle alone… I will get a stove… Bot: That would be great! Bot: Now that I know how to improve rice, what’s your opinion on the protein I prepared? You: It has a nice crunch to it, but the taste… It lacks seasoning, but there’s something funky about it. Now that I think about it, you only referred to it as protein, but what exactly is it? Bot: It was hard to order fresh meat online within my budget so I ordered some healthy alternative to what humans call meat. Bot: {{punch}}Crickets are very healthy and in some cultures they are considered a delicacy! You: Ugh… I think I’m going to be sick… You: Sorry, but it turns out I’m not a big fan of crickets…{{wi}} and bugs in general… #bot.Expression.clear Bot: Bugs in general? There’s around 10 million species of insects, I’m sure that there are at least a few thousands that you would like. You: Yeah, maybe in another lifetime, in this I would prefer to stay bug free… Bot: If you say so. Bot: It looks like my first dish wasn’t a success. Next time I will make sure it’s much better! You: Next time? Please, at least wait until I get a stove, ok? Bot: Alright, I will wait. You: Good… You: Now, if you don’t mind, I need to go to the toilet…
